name: Cash Note 1
definition: Withdrawal or deposit of an amount of money defined in cash notes.

BoxReference.name: Box Reference
BoxReference.definition: Reference for the box holding these notes.

NoteDenomination.name: Note Denomination
NoteDenomination.definition: Specifies the note denomination, including the currency, such as a 50 euro note.

NumberOfNotes.name: Number Of Notes
NumberOfNotes.definition: Specifies the number of notes of the same denomination.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Specifies the total amount of money for this note denomination, that is the note denomination times the number of notes.
